question: Among all European Grand Prix races, what is the percentage of the races were hosted in Germany?
evidence: European Grand Prix races refers to races.name = 'European Grand Prix';percentage = divide(COUNT(races where country = Germany and name = 'Europearn Grand Prix'),COUNT(races where name = 'Europearn Grand Prix'))*100
clarification: Count each distinct circuitId only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'Germany' THEN T2.circuitID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.circuitId) FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'European Grand Prix'
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'Germany' THEN T2.circuitID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.circuitId) FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'European Grand Prix'

d.request: Among all European Grand Prix races, what is the percentage of races hosted in Germany, counting each distinct circuitId only once?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN c.circuitId END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.circuitId) FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'

b.request: Among all races named 'European Grand Prix', counting each distinct circuitId only once, what percentage are at circuits located in Germany (distinct German circuitIds divided by distinct circuitIds overall, times 100)?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN c.circuitId END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.circuitId) AS percentage FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'
